parameters.query:
-- Single query drives conditional Excel write and email digest.
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lessons
     WHERE last_seen_at > now() - interval '30 minutes')          AS lessons_touched,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lesson_assets
     WHERE last_seen_at > now() - interval '30 minutes')          AS assets_touched,
  (extract(dow from now()) = 0)                                   AS is_sunday,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lessons WHERE status = 'Active')          AS active_lessons,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lessons WHERE status = 'Draft')           AS draft_lessons,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lessons WHERE status = 'Under review')    AS review_lessons,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lessons WHERE status = 'Retired')         AS retired_lessons,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lessons
     WHERE status <> 'Retired' AND (summary IS NULL OR summary = '')) AS missing_summary,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lessons
     WHERE status <> 'Retired' AND (standards_raw IS NULL OR standards_raw = '')) AS missing_standards,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lesson_assets
     WHERE is_primary AND is_public = false)                       AS plans_not_public,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lesson_assets
     WHERE COALESCE(file_size,0) = 0)                              AS zero_byte_files,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lesson_assets
     WHERE needs_resourcekey)                                       AS resourcekey_files,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT lesson_id) FROM lesson_assets
     WHERE language = 'es')                                        AS lessons_with_spanish,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT lesson_id) FROM lesson_assets
     WHERE language = 'ht')                                        AS lessons_with_creole,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lessons
     WHERE first_seen_at > now() - interval '25 hours')            AS newly_discovered,
  (SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(lesson_id || ': ' || machine_notes, E'\n'), '(none)')
     FROM lessons
    WHERE machine_notes IS NOT NULL AND machine_notes <> ''
      AND status <> 'Retired')                                     AS flagged_rows;

SELECT
    l.lesson_id, l.grade_label, l.grade_sort,
    COALESCE(l.theme, '')                             AS theme,
    l.lesson_number, l.title,
    COALESCE(l.summary, '')                           AS summary,
    COALESCE(l.topic_tags, '')                        AS topic_tags,
    COALESCE(l.concepts, '')                          AS concepts,
    COALESCE(l.standards_raw, '')                     AS standards_raw,
    COALESCE(l.framework, '')                         AS framework,
    l.lesson_url,
    COALESCE(p.download_url, '')                      AS pdf_url,
    l.status,
    COALESCE(l.machine_notes, '')                     AS machine_notes,
    COALESCE(langs.list, 'en')                        AS languages,
    COALESCE(l.unit, '')                              AS unit
FROM lessons l
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT a.download_url FROM servable_assets a
     WHERE a.lesson_id = l.lesson_id AND a.is_primary LIMIT 1
) p ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT a.language, ', ' ORDER BY a.language) AS list
      FROM servable_assets a WHERE a.lesson_id = l.lesson_id
) langs ON true
ORDER BY l.grade_sort NULLS LAST, l.unit NULLS FIRST, l.lesson_number;
